decision.observation: It is now 12:10 a.m.; the farmer is still beside the farmhouse and mailbox, with the Fish Shop trip not yet started.
decision.hypothesis: Returning indoors and sleeping before 2:00 a.m. is safer than beginning the long beach trip tonight.
decision.memory: Willy invited the farmer to the beach for an item; the Fish Shop is on the southeast coast and opens 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. The farmhouse entrance is reached via the central porch stairs west of the farmer.
